details:
# Issue:
The Camera Focus settings are hard to access in VR, the arrow button on the sides just skips over it. This means you need to manually move through the settings bar to reach it.
It looks like there are just to many settings for the 2 "pages" and since the Camera Focus setting is right in the middle it will always be missing when using the arrow buttons to switch between the "pages".
